notes.en:
**Summary and General Analysis**

✦ Boothill is a single target Break DPS who uses his Skill to force him and an enemy into the "Standoff" state, dealing more damage to the enemy target at the cost of him taking more damage as well. His Basic ATK is Enhanced, and he can only target the selected enemy.

✦When breaking or defeating an enemy, Boothill gains "Pocket Trickshot", which increases the Weakness Break Efficiemcy and damage of his Enhanced Basic ATK stacking up to 3 times.

**Investment Priority**

**The Dahlia > Fugue > E1**

**Investment Explanation**

✦ The Dahlia provides invaluable break support that makes her a neccecity for break teams.

✦ Fugue's Exo-Toughness mechanic helps Boothill quickly gain "Pocket Trickshot", along with her other utilities.

✦ Boothill's E1 helps with his early "Pocket Trickshot" ramp up.
